<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse Detection Module</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="WAIT_FOR_1">Waiting for '1' state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PULSE">Pulse detected state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="RESET">Reset state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state">State variable to store the current state of the pulse detection process.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state">Next state variable to store the upcoming state after state transition.</reg>
        
        // State transitions based on data_in
        <always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = WAIT_FOR_1;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                
                WAIT_FOR_1: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = PULSE;
                    else
                        next_state = WAIT_FOR_1;
                end
                
                PULSE: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = RESET;
                    else
                        next_state = IDLE;
                end
                
                RESET: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    else
                        next_state = RESET;
                end
            endcase
        end
        
        // Update state on the rising edge of clk
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n)
                state <= IDLE;
            else
                state <= next_state;
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Implement the logic for pulse detection and output generation here.</implementation>
</module>
